levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Bullet points are vague ('helped out') with no specific action or result.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Most bullet points name a specific action and a real, concrete result.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All four bullet points name a specific action verb, a concrete result, and read as genuinely distinct from each other.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: A bullet point appears exaggerated or describes something inconsistent with the warm-up list.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All bullet points are consistent with the real activities listed in the warm-up.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Bullet points are consistent with the warm-up and avoid inflated titles or invented scope.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Ordering has no stated reasoning, or the reasoning doesn't match the actual order.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Ordering reasoning connects to the learner's stated interest from Unit 1.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Ordering reasoning is specific about why each top item matters for the kind of work targeted.

lookFors: Each bullet point begins with a distinct action verb, not the same verb repeated.
No bullet point describes a role, title, or outcome absent from the learner's own warm-up list.
The reflection names one specific activity, not a general statement about the exercise.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
